episode_title: Patients Are Asking ChatGPT Which Chiropractor to See
question: How do patients find chiropractors using ChatGPT compared to traditional Google search?
transcript_excerpt: With ChatGPT, patients have conversational interactions asking specific questions like 'I'm 50 years old and have sciatica pain, never had it before,' leading to five or more questions deep into the AI conversation. This creates significantly higher intent search traffic—three to 11 times higher than Google—because of how the user engages with the AI rather than simply entering a keyword phrase and receiving 10 blue links.

episode_title: Patients Are Asking ChatGPT Which Chiropractor to See
question: What schema markup should chiropractor websites implement for ChatGPT AI recommendations?
transcript_excerpt: There are five different types of schema: speakable content schema, FAQ schema, article schema, business schema, and speech-to-text schema. Having all of these installed on your website helps AI engines recognize and recommend you more easily. A webmaster can install at least the basics to put your practice on the right foot for AI recognition.

episode_title: Patients Are Asking ChatGPT Which Chiropractor to See
question: Why do screenshot testimonials on social media not help chiropractors rank in ChatGPT?
transcript_excerpt: ChatGPT does not scan Facebook and Instagram images directly and cannot read screenshots of testimonials. If testimonials are only posted as image screenshots on social media, ChatGPT cannot index them. You must compile all social proof into a place on your website that is easily readable and digestible for the AI, because volume of indexed testimonials actually matters for status and recommendation.

episode_title: Patients Are Asking ChatGPT Which Chiropractor to See
question: What percentage of AI searches use ChatGPT versus other conversational AI platforms?
transcript_excerpt: Almost 70% of all AI searches are on ChatGPT, making it the dominant platform for AI search. While other platforms like Perplexity or Grok exist, if you want to rank your chiropractic practice and get AI to recommend you, it is wise to start with ChatGPT given where the attention and user base are concentrated.

episode_title: Patients Are Asking ChatGPT Which Chiropractor to See
question: What are the key differences between Google SEO and AI Engine Optimization for chiropractors?
transcript_excerpt: Both Google and ChatGPT value original content, recency, authority, and relevance. The primary difference is how users search: Google users see 10 blue links for a keyword query, while ChatGPT users have conversational interactions, drilling down deeper and talking to the AI like a friend. ChatGPT also emphasizes diversification and recency of reviews across multiple platforms like Yelp and Bing/Facebook, not just Google reviews.
